shorts.title: Stop ChatGPT Infinite Loops
shorts.hook: If ChatGPT keeps repeating itself or stuck loading, do this right now.
shorts.script: Open your account settings and scroll down to Data Controls. Clear your local cache and turn off background web sync. Force close the app and reopen it. This resets your session memory and stops endless loading loops instantly.

shorts.title: Fix Broken ChatGPT Voice
shorts.hook: Is your ChatGPT voice acting strange or cutting off?
shorts.script: Open settings and go to Speech. Switch from Live Mode back to Standard Voice. If standard is missing, toggle background audio off and restart the app. This fixes audio freezing on iOS and Android.
